payload.title: Capture: SEC EDGAR fetch with a declared User-Agent contact and data.sec.gov JSON endpoints
payload.description: sec.gov refuses anonymous automated requests (403 'Your Request Originates from an Undeclared Automated Tool'), so every EDGAR Reference captures as blocked and gets no text or summary. Needed: a User-Agent of the form '<name> <contact>' where the contact is read from AWS config/SSM (SecureString per ssm-over-secrets-manager), never from the repo; use it only for sec.gov / data.sec.gov hosts; stay under 10 requests/second. Prefer data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json and data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json for deal terms and financials over the 10-K HTML (a 300k-character filing is cut at 400 KB of markup). Needs a person to supply the contact value. Guide note already added in docs/agent-cli-guide.md (references text PR).
